sentence: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
text: The sample(s) of the ESA shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

test_case: Inspect the ESA sample for the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation, and check the marking is clearly legible and indelible after a rub test.
quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

sentence: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
text: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts shall not need a type approval only if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
condition: The lamp is supplied as a replacement part without its own R10 type approval.
test_case: Check the replacement-part ESA carries an identification number marking it as a replacement part, and compare it with the original equipment for identity and the same manufacturer.
quote: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.

sentence: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
text: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
condition: The lamp's LED electronics constitute (part of) a light source.
test_case: Verify the documentation contains either the R37/R99/R128 approval number of the ESA or a Technical Service report confirming it is not mechanically interchangeable with any R37/R99/R128 light source.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.

sentence: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.

quote: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.

sentence: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.

sentence: Electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation. No marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
test_case: Inspect a production ESA and confirm that the paragraph 5.3 approval mark is affixed to it, unless the ESA is approved only as part of the vehicle.
quote: Electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation. No marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.

sentence: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
test_case: Inspect the mark and verify that it shows a circled "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.
quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

sentence: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
test_case: Inspect the mark and verify that "10R-" and the approval number appear to the right of the circle.
quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.

sentence: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
text: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.

quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.

sentence: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
test_case: Review the design and EMC test results to confirm that the ESA, in normal conditions of use, meets the R10 emission and immunity requirements.
quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

sentence: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

sentence: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
text: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.

sentence: Method of measurement The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

sentence: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

sentence: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.

sentence: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.
text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.
condition: The lamp's LED modules/driver electronics form an ESA that is not exempt as a passive ESA (presence of active electronics not stated).
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 400 MHz and verify all values are below the 62-52 dBµV/m and 52-63 dBµV/m logarithmic limit lines of Appendix 6.
quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.

sentence: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dBµV/m.
condition: The lamp's LED modules/driver electronics form an ESA that is not exempt as a passive ESA (presence of active electronics not stated).
test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz and verify all values are below 63 dBµV/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.

sentence: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

sentence: Method of testing The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2:2011, as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 18.

sentence: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9: - for the levels in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 19a.
text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 for the levels in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 19a (BCI 60 mA in 20 to 400 MHz; ALSE 30 V/m in 80 to 2,000 MHz and 10 V/m in 2,000 to 6,000 MHz).

sentence: Conformity of production The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in Schedule 1 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the following requirements:

sentence: Vehicles or components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7. above.

sentence: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).
text: If the Type Approval Authority is not satisfied with the checking procedure of the manufacturer, when the conformity of a component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
condition: The lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) and is type-approved as an ESA under UN R10
test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband radiated emissions of a series-production ESA per Annexes 7 and 8 and confirm levels are no more than 4 dB above the paragraph 6.5.2.1 and 6.6.2.1 limits.
quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).

sentence: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.
text: If the Type Approval Authority is not satisfied with the checking procedure of the manufacturer, when the conformity of a component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
condition: The lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) and is type-approved as an ESA under UN R10
test_case: Expose a series-production ESA to radiated fields up to 80 % of the paragraph 6.8.2.1 levels per Annex 9 and confirm no observable degradation of the lamp functions.
quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.

sentence: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1. above.
text: If the Type Approval Authority is not satisfied with the checking procedure of the manufacturer, when the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
condition: The lamp contains electronic content (LED driver/control electronics) and is type-approved as an ESA under UN R10
test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses per paragraph 6.9.1 and measure conducted emissions per paragraph 6.7.1 on a series-production sample; confirm no degradation of immunity-related functions and emissions within limits.
quote: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1. above.

sentence: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.

sentence: In this measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

sentence: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

sentence: Measurements can be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors. The limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors. If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
text: If peak detectors are used for the measurements, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation, which are for quasi-peak detectors.
condition: The lamp is an ESA subject to radiated broadband emission testing (not exempt as a passive ESA), and peak detectors are used.

quote: Measurements can be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors. The limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors. If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

sentence: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Table 1 and Table 2.

sentence: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.

sentence: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

sentence: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

sentence: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;

sentence: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

sentence: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

condition: The band- or strip-shaped lamp's light-emitting surface consists of juxtaposed elements.
