quote: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and are not less than 0.8 m long; the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends; the light-emitting surface may be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

sentence: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface along the reference axis above ground and compare with the height limits.
quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis. Where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.

sentence: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
condition: Reduced geometric visibility angles are applied due to lamp mounting height.
test_case: Where reduced vertical visibility angles are claimed, measure the lamp height from its H plane and confirm the height criterion for reduction is met.
quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.

sentence: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
test_case: Operate each lamp function on the vehicle and confirm intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON, absent a specific provision allowing variation.
quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

sentence: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
condition: Lamp intensity varies with ambient light (variable intensity not stated)
test_case: Measure photometry at each ambient-light-dependent intensity state and confirm every state meets the lamp's technical provisions.
quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

sentence: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
condition: Lamp photometry changes when other lamps are switched ON or OFF
test_case: Measure the lamp with other lamps switched ON and OFF and confirm each state complies with the lamp's technical provisions.
quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

sentence: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
condition: Position and stop lamps share light sources (reciprocally incorporated) – not confirmed
test_case: Measure the shared lamp in each function mode and confirm compliance with the technical provisions of each function.
quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

sentence: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
test_case: Verify per paragraph 5.10.4.1 that the red rear lamp apparent surfaces are not directly visible from Zone 1, 25 m in front of the vehicle.
quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

sentence: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);
text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
test_case: Sight check or CAD line-of-sight analysis from Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle shows no direct view of the red rear position/stop lamp apparent surfaces.
quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

sentence: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1 shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
test_case: Check the lamp type-approval photometric report: red light intensity emitted forwards is at most 0.25 cd per lamp, considering vehicle body influence.
quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

sentence: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
test_case: Operate the lighting switch on the vehicle and confirm the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the front position, side-marker, end-outline and registration plate lamps.
quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

sentence: This requirement does not apply while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) Front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) Side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) Daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) Front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1. below.
text: The requirement of paragraph 5.11 shall not apply while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) Front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) Side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) Daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) Front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
test_case: Review the vehicle wiring logic and confirm any non-simultaneous switching of the rear position lamps occurs only in the listed exempted conditions.
quote: This requirement does not apply while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) Front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) Side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) Daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) Front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1. below.

sentence: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
condition: Lamp function is built as an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split body/tailgate) – not stated
test_case: Activate the function and confirm all light sources of the interdependent lamp system switch ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

sentence: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON. This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON, except that this requirement shall not apply to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
test_case: Switch ON headlamps/front fog lamps on the vehicle and confirm the rear position lamps are also ON, except during headlamp flashing warnings.
quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON. This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.

sentence: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm the rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector are not concealable by any cover or mechanism.
quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Reversing lamp: White
text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the reversing lamp light and confirm they fall within the white colour boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Reversing lamp: White

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Stop lamp: Red
text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the stop lamp light and confirm they fall within the red colour boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Stop lamp: Red

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear position lamp: Red
text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the rear position lamp light and confirm they fall within the red colour boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear position lamp: Red

sentence: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red
text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be red.
test_case: Measure the colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector under standard illuminant and confirm it is within the red boundaries.
quote: The colours of the light emitted by the lamps are the following: ... Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

sentence: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
test_case: Count the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors fitted on the vehicle and compare against the numbers in the individual specifications.
quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

sentence: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
condition: Lamp (or part of it) is mounted on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid
test_case: Where the lamp is on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20.
quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

sentence: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
condition: Rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is mounted on a movable component
test_case: With the movable component in each fixed position, measure position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamps and confirm all requirements are met.
quote: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

sentence: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
text: In the case where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
condition: Function on a movable component is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D"
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify that at least one of the "D" lamps meets position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements.
quote: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.

sentence: Where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
condition: Lamp on movable component relies on additional lamps switched ON when the component is open
test_case: Open the movable component to each fixed open position and verify the additional lamps switch ON and meet position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements.
quote: Where additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.

sentence: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system either of the following conditions shall apply: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or
text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system, should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied, except that additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system fully mounted on a movable component
test_case: Verify the interdependent lamp system meets paragraph 5.18.1 at all fixed positions, or that additional lamps switched ON in open positions meet all applicable requirements.
quote: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system either of the following conditions shall apply: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied. However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or

sentence: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s). The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system, should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) being deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify the specified interdependent lamp(s) meet position, outwards geometric visibility, colour and photometric requirements.
quote: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s). The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

sentence: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
condition: Lamp (or part of it) is mounted on a movable component
test_case: With the movable component open, assess the lamps installed on it for glare or undue discomfort to road users.
quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

sentence: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
condition: Lamp (or part of it) is installed on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid
test_case: Open and close the movable component repeatedly and verify that the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position each time.
quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

sentence: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use". Fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.
text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
condition: Vehicle has a movable component able to hide the rear position lamp or retro-reflector
test_case: With the movable component in each manufacturer-specified fixed position, measure the hidden share of the apparent surface along the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 %.
quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use". Fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.

sentence: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or
text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
condition: Rear position lamp or retro-reflector can be more than 50 % hidden by a movable component
test_case: Place the movable component in a position hiding more than 50 % of the apparent surface and verify that compliant additional lamps switch ON.
quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

sentence: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable and no additional lamps are switched ON, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road, except that paragraph 5.21.2. does not apply to retro-reflectors.
condition: Rear position lamp can be more than 50 % hidden by a movable component and no additional lamps are provided
test_case: Inspect the vehicle for the user notice with the prescribed content.
quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

sentence: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
test_case: Verify that each lamp function operates on the vehicle with only the light source and/or fuse installed.
quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.

sentence: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved to UN R37
test_case: Replace the light source on the vehicle using only vehicle-supplied tools and without expert help; pass if replacement is correct.
quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

sentence: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
text: For lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, the vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved to UN R37
test_case: Check the vehicle documentation for a detailed light source replacement procedure.
quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

sentence: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.
text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
condition: Light source module includes a holder for an R37 replaceable light source
test_case: Verify the R37 light source in the module can be replaced per paragraph 5.23.
quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.

sentence: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
condition: Lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and verify the replacement function matches colour, main intensity and position while the replacement device still performs its original function.
quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

sentence: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
condition: Lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate failure and verify the dashboard tell-tale indicates the temporary replacement and need for repair.
quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

sentence: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be allowed, provided that the intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Vary the controlling conditions and measure intensities of all variable lamps; pass if they vary together in the same manner and similar proportion.
quote: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that: (a) The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

sentence: (b) In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
text: For rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio across the full variation range and transitions; pass if the prescribed ratio is maintained.
quote: (b) In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.

sentence: Environmental conditions Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.
text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, shall be allowed in relation to the following environmental conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.
condition: Lamp has variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2)
test_case: Verify intensity variation is triggered only by the listed environmental conditions and stays within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulation.
quote: Environmental conditions Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions: (a) Ambient lighting, (b) Fog, (c) Snowfall, (d) Rain, (e) Spray, (f) Dust clouds, (g) Contamination of the light emitting surface.

sentence: Traffic conditions Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m. However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, shall be allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m, except that as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
condition: Lamp has variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2)
test_case: Verify intensity decrease activates only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m and remains active no longer than speed ≤ 50 km/h.
quote: Traffic conditions Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1. a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m. However as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.

sentence: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition. It may be possible for the driver to set the functions above to static luminous intensities.
text: For lamps with variable luminous intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
condition: Lamp has variable luminous intensity control (R2/S2)
test_case: Record intensity over a transition; pass if no sharp step in intensity is observed.
quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition. It may be possible for the driver to set the functions above to static luminous intensities.

sentence: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved, except that this shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
condition: Lamp approved at a special/requested voltage and does not include electronic light source control gear, integral variable intensity control or only R128 light sources
test_case: Measure terminal voltage on the vehicle at constant voltage operation; pass if it does not exceed the approved voltage.
quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

sentence: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent. The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except that this shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
condition: Lamp does not include electronic light source control gear, integral variable intensity control or only R128 light sources
test_case: Measure terminal voltage at each function on the vehicle at constant voltage operation; pass if ≤ 13.5 V +3 % (12 V system) or the corresponding value.
quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent. The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.

sentence: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, check over the full angles of geometric visibility that no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface (obstacles present at lamp type approval excepted).
quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

sentence: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
test_case: Review the geometric visibility measurement set-up and confirm that near-field observations use parallel-shifted directions of observation.
quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

sentence: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
condition: Part of the apparent surface of the installed lamp is hidden by other vehicle parts
test_case: Where masking occurs, measure photometry of the lamp with the vehicle masking reproduced and confirm the values prescribed for device approval are met.
quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

sentence: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
condition: Lamp mounted at less than 750 mm above the ground with vertical visibility angle reduced to 5°
test_case: Measure mounting height per 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify photometry over the field down to 5° below horizontal.
quote: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.

sentence: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Any function of the rear lamp is realised as an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify the geometric visibility angles are met.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.

sentence: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable LED modules
test_case: Check the lamp component approval communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable.
quote: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.

sentence: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
test_case: Verify the lamp carries valid approval marks under the device regulations (R148 for position/stop/reversing, R150 for retro-reflector).
quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

sentence: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
condition: Lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: If a logo is incorporated, confirm the lamp holds an R148 approval covering the logo.
quote: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.

sentence: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
condition: Lamp is approved for replaceable light source categories (R37/R99/R128)
test_case: Inspect fitted light sources and confirm each carries approval for the category stated in the lamp approval.
quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.

sentence: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s), is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive. To verify that this statement is respected, both at the type approval and in the conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
text: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) shall be allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.
condition: Lamp is equipped with LED substitute light source(s)
test_case: Check the vehicle approval statement per 3.2.8 is positive and the lamp bears the LED substitute light source marking.
quote: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s), is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive. To verify that this statement is respected, both at the type approval and in the conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.

sentence: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4. Optional on trailers of category O1.
text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle and confirm that at least one reversing lamp is fitted.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4. Optional on trailers of category O1.

sentence: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
text: One reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
test_case: Count the reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if there are one or two devices.
quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

sentence: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
test_case: Check the reversing lamp approval certificate and marking; pass if it shows approval to UN R23 or UN R148 (00 or later series).
quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

sentence: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
text: The reversing lamp shall be at a height of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
test_case: Measure the height of the reversing lamp apparent surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if it is between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.
quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

sentence: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle, except that if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. are fulfilled.
test_case: Inspect the installation; pass if the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

sentence: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle (or by CAD) that the reversing lamp apparent surface is unobstructed within α = 15° up/5° down and β = 45° right/left (one device) or 45° outwards/30° inwards (two devices).
quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

sentence: Rearwards
text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
test_case: Inspect the installed lamp; pass if the reference axis of the reversing lamp points rearwards.
quote: Rearwards

sentence: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible. It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable and confirm the lamp lights; confirm it cannot be lit otherwise.
quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible. It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

sentence: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible. It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
test_case: Functional test: with the lamp lit, disengage reverse and separately switch the propulsion system off; pass if the lamp switches OFF in each case and does not light when either condition is absent.
quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible. It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

sentence: Tell-tale Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
text: The tell-tale for the reversing lamp shall be optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
test_case: Check the component regulation (R148) and vehicle wiring: if failure indication is required for the reversing lamp, verify that a failure tell-tale is fitted and activates on lamp failure.
quote: Tell-tale Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

sentence: Moreover, the electrical connections of the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.
text: The electrical connections of the two optional reversing lamps mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.
condition: Only if the lamp is used as one of the two optional reversing devices of paragraph 6.4.2.2 (not normally fitted on M1 vehicles).
test_case: With the lamps of paragraph 5.11 OFF, attempt to switch ON the optional reversing devices; pass if they cannot be switched ON.
quote: Moreover, the electrical connections of the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.

sentence: The devices fitted on the side of the vehicle may be switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, provided that the following conditions are fulfilled: (a) The devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control;
text: When the optional reversing devices fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, the devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control.
condition: Only if optional side-mounted reversing devices of paragraph 6.4.2.2 are used for forward slow manoeuvres.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the side reversing devices are switched ON and OFF only by a separate manual control during forward manoeuvring.
quote: The devices fitted on the side of the vehicle may be switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, provided that the following conditions are fulfilled: (a) The devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control;

sentence: (c) They shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control; in this case they shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.
text: When the optional reversing devices fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion, the devices shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control.
condition: Only if optional side-mounted reversing devices of paragraph 6.4.2.2 are used for forward slow manoeuvres.
test_case: Drive forward with the devices ON and exceed 15 km/h; pass if the devices switch OFF automatically regardless of control position.
quote: (c) They shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control; in this case they shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.

sentence: (c) They shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control; in this case they shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.
text: When the optional reversing devices fitted on the side of the vehicle have been automatically switched OFF because the forward speed of the vehicle exceeded 15 km/h, the devices shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.
condition: Only if optional side-mounted reversing devices of paragraph 6.4.2.2 are used for forward slow manoeuvres.
test_case: After automatic switch-off above 15 km/h, reduce speed below 15 km/h; pass if the devices stay OFF until the control is operated again.
quote: (c) They shall be automatically switched OFF if the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h, regardless of the position of the separate control; in this case they shall remain switched OFF until deliberately being switched ON again.

sentence: Presence Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
text: Devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

test_case: Count the stop lamps installed on the vehicle and confirm there are exactly two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.
quote: Number Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

sentence: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

sentence: In width: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; For the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes there is no special requirement.
text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge on the vehicle and confirm it is ≤ 400 mm.
quote: In width: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; For the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes there is no special requirement.

sentence: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

sentence: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.
text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm that the stop lamps are installed at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.

sentence: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle. sentence: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.

sentence: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.

sentence: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
condition: The stop lamps of the rear lamp are used to give the emergency stop signal

quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.

sentence: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
condition: The stop lamps of the rear lamp are used to give the emergency stop signal

quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

sentence: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.

quote: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.

sentence: Approved lamps emitting white light with the exception of main beam head lamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps may be switched ON as exterior courtesy lamp(s). sentence: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
text: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.

quote: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.

sentence: Number In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the number may be less than or equal to the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp.

condition: The rear position lamp (or another function of the lamp) is used to produce an answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Count the lamps operating as answer-back signal and check that the number does not exceed the number specified for that lamp function.
quote: Number In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the number may be less than or equal to the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp.

sentence: Arrangement In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
text: The arrangement of the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
condition: The rear position lamp (or another function of the lamp) is used to produce an answer-back signal on the vehicle

quote: Arrangement In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

sentence: In width: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
text: The position in width of the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
condition: The rear position lamp (or another function of the lamp) is used to produce an answer-back signal on the vehicle

quote: In width: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

sentence: In height: in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
text: The position in height of the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
condition: The rear position lamp (or another function of the lamp) is used to produce an answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Measure the mounting height on the vehicle and check it against the height provisions for the lamp function used.
quote: In height: in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

sentence: In length: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
