condition: The rear position lamp (or another function of the lamp) is used to produce an answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Check the longitudinal position on the vehicle against the length provisions for the lamp function used.
quote: In length: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

sentence: Geometric visibility In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the geometric visibility may be reduced in comparison to the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp.
text: The geometric visibility of the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal, except that the geometric visibility may be reduced in comparison to the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp.
condition: The rear position lamp (or another function of the lamp) is used to produce an answer-back signal on the vehicle
test_case: Verify the visibility angles on the vehicle and check that they do not exceed the angles specified for the lamp function used.
quote: Geometric visibility In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal. However, the geometric visibility may be reduced in comparison to the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp.

sentence: Orientation In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
text: The orientation of the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

sentence: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
text: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.

sentence: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line. However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
text: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line, except that front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps shall not be permitted to be used.
condition: Applies only if a lamp of this assembly is used for an answer-back signal; the stop lamp shall never be used for it.
test_case: Review the answer-back wiring and the photometric data; pass if only approved lamps of 700 cd maximum on or above HH are used and the stop lamp is not activated.
quote: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line. However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.

sentence: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
text: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
condition: Applies only if a lamp of this assembly is used for an answer-back signal.

quote: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.

sentence: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds. This time is defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
text: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, this time being defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
condition: Applies only if a lamp of this assembly is used for an answer-back signal.
test_case: Trigger the answer-back signal and time it from start to end; pass if the duration is 3 s or less.
quote: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds. This time is defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.

sentence: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.
text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6.
test_case: Carry out a conformity of production check of the installed lamps on production vehicles; pass if they meet paragraphs 5 and 6 as approved.
quote: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.

sentence: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded: - In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground;
text: For the visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded, in their respective planes, in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
test_case: Check on the vehicle that no direct white light from the lamp is visible to the rear in zone 2 between 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground, reversing lamp excepted.
quote: In their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer are bounded: - In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground;

sentence: - In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
text: For the visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear (paragraph 5.10.4.), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
test_case: Construct the 15° outward vertical planes through the vehicle's overall-width contact points and verify that no red light is visible to the front in zone 1 and no white light to the rear in zone 2, reversing lamp excepted.
quote: - In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.

sentence: - In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
text: If there are several points of contact of the vertical planes delimiting the vehicle's overall width, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
test_case: Verify in the visibility-zone construction that the foremost contact point defines the forward plane and the rearmost contact point defines the rearward plane.
quote: - In width, by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.

sentence: In the case where the non‑textured outer lens is excluded, "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. and F1 shall not be transparent to F2:
text: In the case where the non-textured outer lens is excluded and "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2., F1 shall not be transparent to F2.
condition: Whether the position and stop lamps (or other functions) are reciprocally incorporated with the layout shown in example 7b
test_case: Inspect the optical design and light the F2 function alone to confirm that no F2 light passes through the F1 light-emitting area.
quote: In the case where the non‑textured outer lens is excluded, "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2. and F1 shall not be transparent to F2:

sentence: Position of lamps The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
text: For control of conformity of production, the position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
test_case: On a production vehicle, measure the width, height and length position of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector per paragraphs 2.10.2-2.10.4, 2.3.3 and 5.4; pass if the measurement follows those methods.
quote: Position of lamps The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.

sentence: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Compare measured mounting distances of each rear lamp function on production vehicles against the individual installation specifications; pass if all are within the limits.
quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

sentence: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
text: For control of conformity of production, the angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
test_case: Check geometric visibility angles of the installed rear lamp functions per paragraph 2.10.7; pass if the check is performed per that method.
quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.

sentence: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
test_case: Measure visibility angles of each rear lamp function on production vehicles; pass if they meet the individual specifications within the ±3° mounting allowance.
quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.

sentence: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
text: For control of conformity of production, the visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
test_case: On a production vehicle, check that red light from the rear lamp is not visible from the front and white light (other than the reversing lamp) is not visible from the rear per paragraph 5.10; pass if compliant.
quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.

sentence: Electrical connections and tell-tales The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
text: For control of conformity of production, the electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
test_case: Switch on the rear position, stop and reversing lamps on a production vehicle via the vehicle electrical system; pass if each lamp is activated by its control.
quote: Electrical connections and tell-tales The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.

sentence: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
text: For control of conformity of production, the lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
test_case: Operate each rear lamp function and associated tell-tales on a production vehicle; pass if switching behaviour meets paragraphs 5.11-5.14 and individual lamp specifications.
quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

sentence: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
text: For control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.

quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.

sentence: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
text: For control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

sentence: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.

quote: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.

sentence: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.

quote: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.

sentence: A separate approval is required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

sentence: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.

sentence: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.

sentence: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.
text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 minute, after 10 minutes and after photometric stability has occurred.
test_case: Check that any calculated 1 min and 10 min distributions use the HV ratios measured after 1 min, 10 min and photometric stability.
quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.

sentence: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

test_case: Operate the rear position and stop lamps and measure luminous intensities after 1 min and after 30 min (or photometric stability); all values must lie within the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
test_case: Check that any calculated 1 min distribution uses the HV ratio measured after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stabilization.
quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.

sentence: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
condition: A lamp function uses incandescent (filament) light sources only
test_case: Measure luminous intensities after photometric stability; values must lie within the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. Front and rear position 4 HV
text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure or calculate the rear position lamp intensity distribution 4 s after switch ON using the HV ratio; values must comply with the limits.
quote: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. Front and rear position 4 HV

sentence: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. Stop 0.2 HV
text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure or calculate the stop lamp intensity distribution 0.2 s after switch ON using the HV ratio; values must comply with the limits.
quote: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. Stop 0.2 HV

sentence: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. Reversing 0.2 HV
text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure or calculate the reversing lamp intensity distribution 0.2 s after switch ON using the HV ratio; values must comply with the limits.
quote: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1. Reversing 0.2 HV

sentence: The luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.
text: The luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.
test_case: Verify that calculated distributions apply the ratio measured at the function's reference coordinate.
quote: The luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.

sentence: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
test_case: Confirm LED-only technology for each function and that the paragraph 1.2 measurements comply; then no additional time-point testing is needed.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.

sentence: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
text: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
condition: A lamp function uses more than one light generating technology
test_case: Test the function at the strictest time points from paragraphs 2.1.1 to 2.1.3; intensities must comply.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.

sentence: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
test_case: If run-up is irregular, record intensity continuously from the Table A8-1 time until photometric stability; minimum intensities must be met throughout.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.

sentence: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
text: A separate approval shall be required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that the retro-reflector integrated in the rear lamp holds its own UN R150 approval, separate from the lamp-function approvals.
quote: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.

sentence: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
text: The approval number assigned to each type approved shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector sample; pass if the assigned approval number is marked on the device in the manner required by paragraph 3.3.
quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.

sentence: If the approval granted in respect of a retro-reflecting device is extended to other such devices differing only in colour, the two samples in any other colour submitted in conformity with paragraph 3.1.1.1. (d) or 3.1.1.4. of this Regulation shall be required to meet only the colorimetric and photometric specifications, the other tests no longer being required. This paragraph is not applicable to devices of Class IVA.
text: If the approval granted in respect of a retro-reflecting device is extended to other such devices differing only in colour, the two samples in any other colour submitted in conformity with paragraph 3.1.1.1. (d) or 3.1.1.4. of this Regulation shall be required to meet the colorimetric and photometric specifications, the other tests no longer being required, except that this paragraph is not applicable to devices of Class IVA.
condition: Only if the retro-reflector approval is extended to variants differing only in colour.
test_case: For each colour-variant sample, perform colorimetric and photometric tests; pass if both meet the Regulation's specifications.
quote: If the approval granted in respect of a retro-reflecting device is extended to other such devices differing only in colour, the two samples in any other colour submitted in conformity with paragraph 3.1.1.1. (d) or 3.1.1.4. of this Regulation shall be required to meet only the colorimetric and photometric specifications, the other tests no longer being required. This paragraph is not applicable to devices of Class IVA.

sentence: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) IA 5 5.1.
text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) shall be IA, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
condition: Retro-reflector is class IA (independent); class not stated
test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the device and verify the class symbol reads "IA" and character height a is at least 5 mm.
quote: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) IA 5 5.1.

sentence: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) IB 5 5.1.
text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) shall be IB, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
condition: Retro-reflector is class IB (combined with non-watertight signal lamps); class not stated
test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the device and verify the class symbol reads "IB" and character height a is at least 5 mm.
quote: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) IB 5 5.1.

sentence: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
test_case: Inspect the device drawing/sample and verify a marking space large enough for the UI or approval marking and other markings per 3.3.4.2 is provided.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.

sentence: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
test_case: Visually check legibility of all markings and perform a rub/durability test; markings must remain legible and intact.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

sentence: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1. Examples of the arrangement of the markings are shown in Annex 10.
text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
test_case: Measure the approval marking dimensions and verify a is not less than the Table 1 value (5 mm for classes IA/IB).
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1. Examples of the arrangement of the markings are shown in Annex 10.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking and verify a circle surrounding "E" followed by the approving country's number is present.
quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the four to six-digit sequential number of the approval number is present.
quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

sentence: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Inspect the marking layout and verify the sequential number is adjacent to the approval mark.
quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) per Table 1 is present.
quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking and verify "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments is present.
quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

sentence: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available. The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)
text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I Unique Identifier (UI).
condition: Unique Identifier used instead of the approval marking
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector marking and confirm the UI mark matches the Figure I format.
quote: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available. The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)

sentence: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector for the applicant's trade name or mark.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

sentence: Retro-reflective devices shall bear in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective devices shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IA/IB and an orientation indication is necessary to determine the angle(s) of rotation
test_case: Check whether rotation angle is ambiguous; if so verify 'TOP' is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

sentence: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
test_case: Visually inspect the device and confirm the approval mark/UI and trade name/TOP markings are clearly legible.
quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

sentence: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed. This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that:
text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed, and this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.6.1.1. and 3.3.6.1.2. are met.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp assembly including the retro-reflector
test_case: Review marking drawing to confirm single approval mark covers all applicable regulations and meets location provisos.
quote: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed. This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that:

sentence: It is visible after their installation.
text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp assembly
test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle and confirm the single approval mark is visible.
quote: It is visible after their installation.

sentence: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp assembly
test_case: Inspect design to confirm the mark is on a part (e.g. lens) whose removal also removes every light-transmitting part.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.

sentence: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined lamp assembly
test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare against the smallest minimum size required by the pertinent regulations.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

sentence: Conformity of production The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the following requirements:
text: The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements of paragraphs 3.5.1. to 3.5.5.
test_case: Audit the manufacturer's CoP procedures against Schedule 1 of the 1958 Agreement.
quote: Conformity of production The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the following requirements:

sentence: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
test_case: Test production samples against paragraphs 4 and 5 and confirm conformity with the approved type.
quote: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

sentence: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with.
text: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with for retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation.
test_case: Audit production control procedures against Annex 2 minimum requirements.
quote: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with.

sentence: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
test_case: Review the retro-reflector against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at application; pass if all feasible requirements are met.
quote: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

sentence: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
test_case: Check that the R48 requirements pertinent to the rear retro-reflector for M1 vehicles that are verifiable at device approval are assessed and met.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

sentence: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
test_case: Inspect design and test results; pass if the retro-reflector functions satisfactorily before and after the prescribed tests.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

sentence: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
test_case: Visually inspect samples; pass if no design or manufacturing defect affecting operation or maintenance is found.
quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.

sentence: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; pass if components cannot be easily separated.
quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

sentence: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector; pass if it can be cleaned easily.
quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

sentence: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the outer surface; pass if not rough and protuberances do not hinder cleaning.
quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

sentence: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; pass if the inner (prism) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.
quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

sentence: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
text: The combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
condition: The retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter (e.g. prism optic behind red lens).
test_case: Attempt to separate optical unit and filter under normal conditions of use; pass if they cannot be separated.
quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

sentence: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish shall not be permitted.
test_case: Review BOM and inspect the optic/filter; pass if colour is obtained by tinted material, not paint or varnish.
quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

sentence: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.

quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.

sentence: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

sentence: White retro-reflective devices must not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device must not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.
text: White retro-reflective devices shall not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device shall not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.
condition: The retro-reflector is white (assumed red).
test_case: Measure x,y change of Illuminant A after reflection; pass if change does not exceed 0.01.
quote: White retro-reflective devices must not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device must not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.

sentence: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5; and
text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
condition: The retro-reflector is of Class IA or IB (class not stated).

quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5; and

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
condition: The retro-reflector is of Class IA or IB (class not stated).

sentence: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
